headline: State Bank of India Reports Record Asset Quality in Q2 Presentation
summary: State Bank of India posted record asset quality for the second quarter of fiscal 2027, while its stock fell 5%.
why: State Bank of India is the country's largest public sector bank, serving as a core pillar of India's banking system and a key indicator of national credit health.

impacts.name: State Bank of India
impacts.why: Despite improving asset quality metrics, equity prices dropped in response to the overall earnings presentation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Profit-taking or specific elements within the earnings presentation led to a 5% drop in the bank's share price despite positive asset quality metrics.
